name: clarto-solicitudes
description: Internal inbox of property searches sent to external collaborators by e-mail and WhatsApp with the complete content, their answers and proposals (panel, e-mail, WhatsApp), replies to link, comparison and property from a selected proposal.
features: Search requests with draft, preview and history
Complete e-mail and WhatsApp to one, several or every active collaborator
Answers from the collaborator panel, e-mail or WhatsApp
Proposal comparison and property from a proposal
